The Subtask Name: Determine the birth years of Mahbub ul Haq and Ibn Arabi and compare them.

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed internet searches to gather information about the birth years of Mahbub ul Haq and Ibn Arabi.
  -- Observation: Found that Ibn Arabi was born in 1165 (July 28) according to Britannica.
  -- Thought: Compared the birth years of both individuals to determine who was born first.
  -- Result: Concluded that Ibn Arabi was born first.

- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Coordinated the search efforts and analysis of the gathered information.
  -- Observation: Noted the discrepancies in the birth years retrieved from different sources.
  -- Thought: Decided to use multiple credible sources to verify the birth years.
  -- Result: Organized the comparison of the birth years to provide a clear conclusion.
